item.description: CONCLUSIONS: To conclude, we present the application of an atomic fact-checking algorithm to medical Q&A. It identifies factual inaccuracies and hallucinations in LLM-generated answers, achieving the greatest gains on clinically realistic, complex questions. item.description: CONCLUSION: This study highlights both shared concerns and differing perspectives regarding AMR among three major outpatient stakeholders involved in antibiotic use. item.title: Novel mTORC1 Booster LAPTM4A Potentiates Pathological Cardiac Hypertrophy
item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Our study identified a novel mTORC1 booster LAPTM4A and verified interrupting the LAPTM4A-mTORC1 axis can significantly inhibit excessive protein synthesis and pathological cardiac hypertrophy, which might represent an attractive therapeutic approach for this disease.
